Class ClassCoverageUtils

java.lang.Object
solvers.queueingnet.treeAlgorithms.ClassCoverageUtils
public class ClassCoverageUtils extends Object
Implements functionality related to class coverage.
Author:
Ben Homer, 2014.

    Class
    Description
    static enum 
    ClassCoverageUtils.Covered
    Enum to represent the 3 types of class coverages: fully-covered, partially-covered and non-covered, as defined in the LamLien83 paper.

    ClassCoverageUtils.Covered
    getClassCoverage(int cls, TreeSet<Integer> subnet)
    With respect to a subset of stations (SUBNET), a) a class of customers is fully covered if the stations that the class visits are a subset of SUBNET, b) a class of customers is noncovered if the intersection between the stations that the class visits and SUBNET is empty, c) a class of customers is partially covered if only some of the stations that the class visits are in SUBNET.

    • getClassCoverage

      public ClassCoverageUtils.Covered getClassCoverage(int cls, TreeSet<Integer> subnet)
      With respect to a subset of stations (SUBNET), a) a class of customers is fully covered if the stations that the class visits are a subset of SUBNET, b) a class of customers is noncovered if the intersection between the stations that the class visits and SUBNET is empty, c) a class of customers is partially covered if only some of the stations that the class visits are in SUBNET.
      Parameters:
      cls - The class of customers.
      subnet - The subnetwork of stations.
      Returns:
      An enum describing whether the class is fully, non or partially covered with respect to the subnetwork.

    • contract

      public PopulationVector contract(PopulationVector largePopVec, TreeSet<Integer> largePcs, TreeSet<Integer> smallPcs)
      Contracts a population vector to the necessary size depending on partially covered classes in smallPcs.
      Parameters:
      largePopVec - The population vector containing populations for each class in largePcs.
      largePcs - The set of partially covered classes corresponding to the largePopVec.
      smallPcs - The set of partially covered classes we want to find populations for.
      Returns:
      The population vector containing populations for each class in smallPcs.

    • nextPermutationUpwards

      public PopulationVector nextPermutationUpwards(PopulationVector pv, PopulationVector orig)
      Returns the next permutation of a population vector to be used in the convolution computation, given the current vector and the original start vector. This version counts upwards instead of down.

      pv - The current permutation of the vector.
